canonical_title: Automatic braking selected by flight crew

versions.title_at_revision: Automatic braking selected by flight crew
versions.text:
Standard: A flight crew initiated automatic braking system will have a means to arm and disarm the system. The system allows the flight crew to override the system at any time with manual braking. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review control panel to verify ability to select braking modes, deceleration rates, power system on and off. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct simulator testing to verify control panel operation. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Flight testing verifies control system maintains selected braking modes, deceleration rates, and ability of flight crew to arm and disarm the system.
